 Tank Dell a Midseason Waiver-Wire Target with Increased Volume 
 4d Link copied! 
 Share: 
 Link copied to clipboard! 
 See RotoBaller at 
 the top of Google 
 Nov 4, 2026, 1:29 AM ET 
Houston Texans wide receiver Tank Dell should handle increased volume going forward due to a variety of factors. First and foremost, Dell is finally healthy. He returned to action in Week 7 following a nearly two-year-long recovery from a very serious knee injury. He is finally back on the field and contributing without any limitations, which should put him firmly back in the mix for fantasy football. Second of all, Dell should handle increased volume within the Texans' offense after Jaylin Noel (toe) was placed on injured reserve. The Texans already lost Jayden Higgins (knee) to a year-long injury, and now, Noel is done for the season, too. His absence provides a clear path to the No. 3 role for Dell, whereas before he would have had to compete for it. While Dell may not be an immediate fantasy starter in his role behind Nico Collins and Marvin Harrison Jr. , he's at least worth stashing as a solid waiver wire pickup ahead of Week 9. -- Andersen Pickard
